dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Another one finished. Mm, and the paint's all dry...

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Oh, happy holidays! Are you here for a Xiao Lantern too?

choices.text: I've released my Xiao Lantern, too.

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: You did? Oh! You made it yourself? I was going to weave one for you.

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: In any case, here's to hoping every wish on our Xiao Lanterns comes true.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are lots of people asking you for lanterns?

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Yep! You know how Miss Pingxi made a customizable lantern frame?

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Well, lots of people bought them to tinker with. Oh, Gaming got one too! I offered to help, but he was adamant about doing it himself.

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Some of my neighbors had an idea about what to make, but didn't know how to execute their vision, so they came to me for some hands-on help.

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: And, after weaving them for everyone else, I made one for myself too.

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Now it's just time to release it... Huh... What wish should I write...?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You and Lan Yan release a Xiao Lantern together...

choices.text: Are lots of people asking you for lanterns?
